The '''Molten Rift''' was a rift deep within the [[Crystal Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was surrounding a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Volcanic activity opened deep magma chasms, releasing rivers of lava to the surface, along with [[Geo Beast|geo beasts]], creatures not accustomed to normal temperatures of the Hoth's freezing surface. Surveys of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] revealed potential treasures already buried in lava during the volcano's activity.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Molten Rift|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

Other creatures who frequented the area were [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] and [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]], aggressively defending their territory.<ref name="TOR" />
